metadata.title: Spectral and convex geometry of $α$-harmonic maps and sharp Morse index rigidity
metadata.abstract: We develop a weighted scalar spectral geometric description of Sacks-Uhlenbeck $\alpha$-harmonic maps into round spheres and identify its convex geometry realization for $\alpha$-harmonic diffeomorphisms onto the round $2$-sphere. More precisely, we establish a one-to-one correspondence, modulo orientation preserving isometries of $\mathbb{S}^2$, between orientation preserving $\alpha$-harmonic diffeomorphisms onto the round $2$-sphere and positive Codazzi tensors satisfying a determinant bound and a compatibility condition with the prescribed metric on $\mathbb{S}^2$. These tensors are the radii tensors of auxiliary strictly convex surfaces, and the weighted scalar forms in spectral geometry equal $-\alpha$ times the second variations of the enclosed volumes with respect to the support functions. Using these spectral geometry and convex geometry results, we prove a sharp Morse index characterization of isometric equatorial parametrizations among $\alpha$-harmonic $2$-spheres in the round $n$-sphere. We also prove that every $\alpha$-harmonic diffeomorphism between unit round $2$-spheres is orthogonal for all $\alpha>1$. Equivalently, the only admissible positive Codazzi tensor whose reconstructed metric on $\mathbb{S}^2$ has Gaussian curvature $1$ is $(\kappa+2)^{\alpha-1}\bar{g}$, where $\bar{g}$ is the unit round metric.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: α调和映射的谱—凸几何刚性
analysis.workSummary: 作者把球面目标的Sacks–Uhlenbeck α调和映射写成加权标量谱几何，并对到单位S²的保向α调和微分同胚建立与正Codazzi张量的对应，张量满足行列式界和源度量兼容条件；对应凸曲面的半径张量，其体积二变分与加权谱二次型相连。
techniques: 支撑函数的体积二变分
analysis.breakthrough: 据此给α调和二球的等距赤道参数化以尖锐Morse指标刻画，并证明任意α>1时单位圆球之间的α调和微分同胚都是正交变换。
analysis.limitations: 对应有保向、行列式和兼容条件，非任意正Codazzi张量。不能将单位圆球微分同胚刚性推广到所有α调和映射；摘要没给指标阈值，勿补造。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
